name: luchuirp_adept
description: a Luchuirp Adept, a short stocky gnome mage: a bushy orange beard, brass-rimmed goggles with blue lenses pushed up on a deep teal hood, teal robes with gold trim and a brown leather belt with a brass buckle, a brown leather satchel stuffed with scrolls on a strap across the chest hanging at his screen-left hip, brown boots, and a tall wooden staff topped with a glowing blue crystal set in a brass cogwheel in his LEFT hand
hands: the cogwheel crystal staff stays upright in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty fist resting on the satchel strap on the screen-left side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut above the orange beard, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (his empty right fist flung out to the left, the cogwheel crystal staff thrown up and out in his left hand), the teal hood jolting back
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the cogwheel crystal staff tilting back, his empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the cogwheel crystal staff high, his empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops into the orange beard, the cogwheel crystal staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the crystal end of the staff resting on the ground at the lower-right, his empty right hand hanging by the satchel
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the cogwheel crystal staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the teal robe flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the goggles still on the teal hood; the cogwheel crystal staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the satchel lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the teal hood and robe settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the cogwheel crystal staff on the ground beside him
